//: Repo-wide typecheck, including tests, scripts and examples (chant #1388).
CI typechecks packages/core and packages/k8s-client, and check-lexicons builds each
lexicon's tsconfig.build.json — which excludes **/*.test.ts, correctly, since a
published lexicon should not ship its tests. The consequence was that nothing
typechecked a lexicon test at all: `tsc -p lexicons/forgejo/tsconfig.build.json
--listFiles | grep -c '.test.ts'` returns 0, while packages/core typechecks its 266.
A type-level assertion written in a lexicon test was evaluated by nothing, which is
why #1344's ChantConfig augmentation proofs had to live in compiled source.
moduleResolution is bundler here, unlike the root config's node. That is deliberate:
this config covers tests and examples, which run under vitest and tsx — both of which
resolve like a bundler. Shipped code keeps its node-resolution build configs, so the
stricter resolution story for published packages is unchanged.
